import re, glob, os, json, collections

LABELS=["Respondent:","Other Party:","Case Number:","Date of Advisory Meeting:","Date of Damage:","Damage Location:","Date of Dam.age:","Dam.age Location:","Date nf Advisory Meeting:"]
def norm(s): return re.sub(r'\s+','',s).lower()
def isutil(name): return any(norm(name).startswith(norm(u)) for u in UT)
def respondent(p):
    s=p
    a=s.find('Respondent:')
    inline=re.search(r'Respondent:[ \t]*([^\n]*)',s).group(1).strip()
    if inline and not any(inline.startswith(l) for l in LABELS):
        return inline, 'inline'
    # block after last header label
    last=-1; lab=None
    for l in LABELS:
        for m in re.finditer(re.escape(l),s):
            if m.end()>last and m.start()<s.find('The IURC') if s.find('The IURC')>0 else True:
                if m.end()>last: last=m.end()
    block=s[last:s.find('The IURC')] if s.find('The IURC')>last else s[last:last+200]
    block=' '.join(block.split())
    return block, 'block'
rows=[]
for fn in sorted(glob.glob(D+'/*.txt')):
    b=os.path.basename(fn)
    t=open(fn,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    for i,p in enumerate(re.split(r'=== page \d+',t)):
        if 'Respondent:' not in p: continue
        m=re.search(r'recommends the following (?:civil )?penalty:',p)

        rec=p[m.end():]
        rec=re.split(r'Abstentions|Additional Information|APPROVED',rec)[0]
        rec=rec.replace('$$','$')
        mm=re.search(r'\$\s*(\d{1,3}(?:,\s*\d{3})+|\d+)',rec)
        pen=int(re.sub(r'[,\s]','',mm.group(1))) if mm else 0
        yr_m=re.search(r'_(\d{2})\.?(\d{2})\.?(\d{2})\.txt$|NPT_(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})\.txt$',b)
